merged_guidance.title: Coalesce latest accepted work in reusable per-owner trailing batches
merged_guidance.applicability: The current task explicitly requests a reusable trailing operation that keeps the latest accepted value until its declared quiet interval, including reuse of an existing utility when required.
merged_guidance.event_relation: Bind pending work to the originating document or key. Each edit replaces the pending value and restarts the quiet interval. At expiry, deliver that batch's latest value once; later independent bursts remain usable.
merged_guidance.preservation: Preserve independent owner tasks, exact text including empty strings, existing interfaces and the guard against writes when no document is current. Navigation must not redirect accepted work to a different owner.
merged_guidance.exclusion: Do not coalesce events that must each be processed. Use the current task's interval; the historical 120 ms value is not a default or new deadline.
merged_guidance.verification: With controlled time, check no early write, restart after a later edit, one latest-value write at expiry, a second independent burst, empty input, independent documents and navigation before execution.

record.title: Coalesce trailing work while preserving the latest value and reuse
record.applicability: The task explicitly requests a reusable trailing operation that retains the latest accepted value after a declared quiet interval.
record.event_relation: Bind work to its originating document or key. Replace pending input and restart the declared quiet interval on each edit; consume the latest value at expiry and keep later bursts usable.
record.preservation: Preserve exact input semantics, including valid empty text, independent keys and the existing no-current-view guard.
record.exclusion: The source cases' 120 ms interval is not a universal default. Do not coalesce events that the current task requires to be processed individually.
record.verification: Use controlled time to check no early execution, deadline restart, one latest-value delivery, later bursts, empty input, independent keys and navigation before execution.

record.title: Coalesce edits per document and restart the quiet interval
record.applicability: The task explicitly requires reusing an existing trailing utility to retain the latest text in an editing burst until a quiet interval expires.
record.event_relation: Replace pending text and restart the timer on every edit. Save only the latest value at expiration, and allow later independent bursts to save again. Use separate tasks for different documents.
record.preservation: Preserve existing interfaces and exact input, including empty strings. Preserve the guard that prevents writes when there is no current document.
record.exclusion: The historical editor cases use 120 ms; this is not a universal constant. Do not discard intermediate values when the task requires processing every event.
record.verification: With a controlled clock, check no early write, deadline restart after another edit, one latest-value write at expiration, a successful second burst, empty text and independent document tasks.

obligation_checklist: Keep empty input and no-current-document guard.
Retain independent keys, restartable quiet interval, later reuse and no hardcoded120ms.
